questions.question: Can typed source identities and completeness boundaries preserve state and event evidence through replay/disorder/recovery?
questions.acceptance: zero unexplained logical identity differences and no silent gap transition

questions.question: What analytical storage versus reconstruction cost trade-off arises from full policy snapshots versus baseline+transitions?
questions.acceptance: correct measurement including negative result; preference thresholds are not guaranteed findings

questions.question: What cost/capacity does recoverable event ingestion add over batch on identical routing occurrences?

rejected: complete BGP state from update-only window
new distributed algorithm or proven horizontal scaling
